During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[SIS listening post (Syvris system)|listening post]] in the [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]] was compromised, causing the Empire to '''attack''' the station while the SIS agents were evacuating. As a result, the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron were dispatched to ensure the agents' safe evacuation before the hostile ships secured the area.
